findings.one_line: The cross-fit evaluation fluctuation in (G8) has conditional variance E[pi_a(1/hatpi_a-1/pi_a)^2] = E[(hatpi_a-pi_a)^2/(pi_a hatpi_a^2)] (approximately E[((hatpi_a-pi_a)/pi_a)^2/pi_a]), not the displayed integral E[(hatpi_a-pi_a)^2/pi_a]; the omitted inverse-pi_a^2 factor requires a separate boundary-cell bound (including the alpha_a<1/2 branch) before (G11)--(G14) follow.

(S2) introduces a permutation-symmetric leading statistic S_{P,N} with samplewise o_P approximation, but the arm theorems supply only distributional arm expansions and no such symmetric coupling; this missing construction is load-bearing for the Hoeffding/U-statistic variance argument (S3)--(S8).
